decision.reasoning_trace: During this shopping session, I prioritized finding a balance between high audio quality and reasonable pricing. I looked closely at the Bang & Olufsen Beosound A1, which has excellent reviews but a very high price point ($279) for a portable speaker. The Bose SoundLink was a strong contender at $99.99, but its design felt somewhat dated compared to newer releases. I also considered the JBL Charge 4, but its 'Renewed' status made me cautious about battery life. The BOGASING M4 offered impressive 40W specs for the price, but as a less established brand, I wasn't ready to commit. Finally, the JBL Go 3 bundle seemed slightly overpriced due to the added case. Because I couldn't find a brand-new, high-power speaker from a top-tier brand that fit my budget perfectly today, I decided not to make a purchase.
